finding.statement: The Trigger-7 Qwen3-ASR and hardware-roundtrip jobs remain unassigned, and an unrelated newer Trigger-4 WP900 job using the same self-hosted/Linux/X64 class is also queued with runner_id=0. The controller currently reports 26 queued workflow runs and zero in-progress runs. This materially strengthens a controller-wide self-hosted executor admission/starvation/access/label problem over a Trigger-7-specific workflow defect, but does not distinguish runner offline/unregistered from runner-group access or label-policy mismatch because runner administration/status is unavailable on the current connector surface.

counterhypotheses_preserved: An eligible runner exists but repository/runner-group access currently prevents assignment.
The registered runner no longer carries one or more required labels.
The runner service is stopped, offline, or unregistered.
A control-plane condition outside runner liveness prevents assignment despite an otherwise healthy host.

coordination.reason: Existing runtime claims are already blocked on the same runner-assignment gate; creating another model job would add queue load without discriminating model behavior.
